scenes.headline: Why Zero-Sum Hierarchies Breed Outrage
scenes.stat_label: FOR YOU TO WIN #1, SOMEONE ELSE MUST DROP
bullets: Hunter-gatherer brains evolved to guard tribe rank

scenes.narration: Status is strictly zero-sum: for you to climb to number one, someone else must be pushed down to number two. That breeds constant politics, envy, and outrage.

scenes.narration: Wealth creation is positive-sum. When you ship a helpful tool or educational guide, your audience wins time and you earn compounding equity without needing anyone to lose.
